title: Not worth it
body: App always asks to check email for verification link and NEVER send the link. REFUND REQUESTED

title: No way to cancel subscription
body: After multiple emails they are no help in assisting me in canceling subscription.

title: Worthless
body: I signed up to see if it worked and was immediately worthless without a “premium “ account.

title: Verify email never comes
body: Won’t let me verify my email. Says that it sends an email but it never arrives - yes, I checked my spam.

title: Bogus company
body: They will hijack your credit card. You’ve been warned.

title: Must buy Premium?
body: No info/service with this app unless premium is purchased at $9.99/ month, auto renewal. Is there a way to use it without a subscription? If so I’ll change the review because it looks like it could be useful.

title: To many glitches
body: I’ve been trying to use the app on my phone and it keeps asking me for an upgrade when trying to search for flights. Very disappointing since the app is charging $10 and wants another $10 for an upgrade

title: Horrible waste
body: There is no search result visible without purchasing the “Premium service” apparently.

title: Not working for new IOS 26
body: Just updated my iPhone to iOS 26 and now whenever I search it just gets stuck

title: Innacurate, good idea though
body: Searches are color coded but the info is not accurate? This app has a lot of potential but there’s not much to it. Also $10 a month is insane, the point of even getting GWP is to save money, that’s $120/year

title: Needs an update to make it worth it
body: For the current price - more than half of what I paid for for 20 months of the GWP - I should at the very least be able to stay signed in and have a saved search. It’s a great idea and is helpful, but the time saved so far is not worth $10 a month. ***Editing to also include that the schedule text and email features don’t work at all.

title: $10 a month. Too expensive!
body: For some reason my original review was deleted. Sure, it could be a handy tool, but not for $10 a month. For that amount you can get most streaming services. I’d be better if they had a one-time payment method or maybe $5 a month.

title: It’s ok; need improvement and the price is just wrong
body: Pros: -very handy for finding go wild domestic fare for the next 2 days Cons: -pretty much useless for finding international go wild fares -doesn’t have a nice calendar view of fares -ui is extremely lackluster -creating an account is near impossible due to email never arriving -searching without an account forces you to type in your search twice, the first search is basically a dummy search that brings you to the real search once you hit the search button Overall take: if you want to charge this much, this better be the best tool ever. Fix the price until you fix the platform. In the end I feel like charging $120/yr to search for fares on a pass most people bought for $300/yr just doesn’t make sense. When paired with a very basic app that has a bunch of bugs, it makes even less sense.

title: Customer journey
body: It’s good for a digital nomad… someone who wants to see cheapest domestic flights. I like that the calendar shows blackout & other booking windows. I hate that I have to enter my flight search info only to be redirected & asked all over again… annoying. But it’s only been a couple days, I’ll report back with update after trial.

title: Beneficial app!
body: Fabulous app that provides so much detail. And I can receive alerts when a GWP becomes available for a route on a future date. So many benefits for a great deal.

title: What’s a $$$ saver!
body: This app is GREAT! I find so many deals that I didn’t know were even an option for me to travel to. Great when you have nothing planned for the weekend and just want to go somewhere new. Must download!

title: Best Go Wild flight finder!
body: This is the best Go Wild app for finding Frontier Go Wild flights. You can search both departure and arrival airports which helps during your vacation/trip planning. They app allows you to search any days on the calendar, you’re not just limited to searching available Go Wild booking dates which is a huge plus for me.

title: Much needed!
body: As a pass holder, I have been waiting for an app like this to be released & hope the developer continues to update & support it. The app itself is very simple to use allowing me to search all flights from my home airport to any or a specific destination on a specified date. It also contains no ads which almost seems criminal as an app like this takes quite some time to make. I would be fine with a 1x small purchase fee or ads in app if it meant it provided the developer some incentive to develop further & compensate for their time. Keep up the good work!
